items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: I guess you never really knew him very much. You heard him. Not too good. I remember hearing him like some other. What was his name? Oktow Phillip.

ctx.x: He died in 19... 19... 1907, 1906 or something. Oh, way back that far. Yeah. That far back. When you were just a little boy. Yeah, I was very small. I guess you never really knew him very much. You heard him. Not too good. I remember hearing him like some other. What was his name? Oktow Phillip. Oktow Phillip.
Oktow Phillip. Oktow Phillip. Oktow Phillip. Oktow Phillip.
